//: Menu button system. Adds a FULLSCREEN on/off toggle to Game Settings (front-end, after HIGH RESOLUTION) and the in-mission pause Game Settings submenu. type=toggle binds to the built-in 'fullscreen' toggle; label_on/off are shown live. The pause labels are space-padded so the centered entry lines up under the native two-column ON/OFF toggles. See docs/adding-menus-and-buttons.md.
